name: aegis-city
description: Aegis City — multiplayer spatial web app (Next.js + Supabase + Socket.io + Pixi.js + Agora).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm --prefix frontend run start" "npm --prefix backend run start"
